1a1464aeda7e.src: 拋完陽光一照還是一圈圈螺旋紋、黑車在戶外整面炫光、交車前紋路還看得到——問題常常出在最後那道收尾沒有專門的盤。RO 訂製鏡面拋光盤（黑色）是 RO 機專用的高密度海綿盤，棉材質盤面，背板用高熱穩定 EVA 再加一層特製緩衝層。在標準拋光流程裡，它排在粗棉盤、中棉盤之後的最後一道，負責收尾提亮，搭配米速拾號 1000 番研磨劑使用。
1a1464aeda7e.en: You finish polishing, and in the sun there are still circles of swirl marks. Outdoors, a black car shows holograms across whole panels. The marks are still visible right before you hand the car back. The problem is usually the last step: no dedicated finishing pad. The RO Custom Mirror Foam Pad (Black) is a high-density foam pad made for RO polishers. The pad face is foam, and the backing is heat-stable EVA with an added custom cushioning layer. In the standard polishing sequence, it comes after the coarse and medium foam pads as the final finishing step, used with MISO No.10 Mirror Finish (1000 grit) compound.

1a340190cc85.src: 拋光的核心不是「機器好不好」，而是<g0>對番數系統的理解、對車漆狀況的判斷、對工序的耐心</g0>。第一次拋光建議從引擎蓋的角落小範圍試做，找到自己的手感後再展開到全車。
1a340190cc85.en: The core of polishing isn't "how good the machine is" - it's <g0>understanding the grit system, judging the paint's condition, and having patience with the process</g0>. For your first time, we recommend trying a small area in a corner of the hood first, then moving to the rest of the car once you've found your feel for it.

1dc88fcabe74.src: 輪圈洗不乾淨、煞車粉塵卡一層黑、卡鉗周圍怎麼刷都灰灰的。這支是針對重油污與煞車粉塵的清潔劑，成分為除鐵助劑、表面活性劑與去離子水。除了輪圈輪胎與行走機構，引擎室、車身上的蟲膠鳥糞、漆面殘留油脂也用得上。稀釋倍率會隨施工工具差到十倍，請依瓶身標示，或加 LINE 向小編確認後再兌水。

This cleaner targets heavy grease and brake dust, with an iron-removal booster, surfactants, and deionized water. Besides wheels, tires, and the running gear, it also works on the engine bay, bug residue and bird droppings on the body, and grease left on paint. The dilution ratio can vary up to tenfold depending on your application tool, so follow the label, or message us on WhatsApp before you dilute it.

1dccd190af2c.src: 用真羊毛或合成羊毛纖維製成。<g0>切削力最高的一類，發熱也最快</g0>。適合搭配 80 番等粗番數研磨劑做重切削。泡泡怪獸 RO 訂製羊毛盤屬於合成羊毛類型，搭配高彈海綿背板降低重切時的燒漆風險，不噴毛、升溫慢，背板為高彈海綿。
1dccd190af2c.en: Made from real or synthetic wool fiber. <g0>This is the highest-cutting pad type, and it also builds up heat the fastest</g0>. Good for heavy cutting with coarse compounds like 80 grit. The POP MONSTER RO Custom Wool Pad is a synthetic wool type paired with a high-resilience foam backing to lower the risk of burning the paint during heavy cutting. It doesn't shed fiber and heats up slowly, with a high-resilience foam backing plate.

1ed4c2ecb1e7.en: Store in a cool, dark place away from heat and direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children. Do not swallow.

1ef5b6903144.src: 羊毛盤切削力強，下壓不穩或吃劑不均容易傷到清漆層；不熟悉的話先從中修、收尾盤練起，再上重切款。
1ef5b6903144.en: Wool pads cut aggressively — uneven pressure or uneven compound coverage can damage the clear coat. If you're new to this, practice with a medium-cut or finishing pad first before moving up to a heavy-cut one.

1f1b96195d50.src: 車身帶水也能分解，不必等車身全乾才做。
1f1b96195d50.en: It still works on a wet car, so you don't have to wait for the car to dry first.

1f2139f56c1b.src: 盤子掉毛、拋到一半羊毛盤變形、RO 重切怕拋穿、GA／DA 震動大下壓力抓不穩——很多時候是盤選錯了，不是手法問題。泡泡怪獸拋光盤系列走 RO／GA／DA 全機型訂製，分羊毛盤與高密度海綿盤兩線：羊毛盤負責切削、海綿盤負責收尾，另有專為 GA／DA 震動頻率開發的款式。盤徑、硬度與轉速等規格仍在確認中，下單前請先加 LINE 告知機型與盤款。
1f2139f56c1b.en: Pads shedding fibers, a wool pad deforming halfway through a job, worried about cutting through the clear coat on a heavy RO cut, GA/DA vibration making it hard to hold steady pressure — a lot of the time that's the wrong pad, not bad technique. POP MONSTER's Polishing Pad Series is made to order for any RO/GA/DA machine and comes in two lines: wool pads and high-density foam pads. Wool pads handle the cutting, foam pads handle the finishing, and there are pads built specifically for GA/DA vibration frequencies. Pad diameter, hardness and speed specs are still being finalized — message us on WhatsApp with your machine and pad type before you order.

1fb91b740045.src: 座椅有油漬、方向盤摸起來黏黏的、皮椅上一塊腳印怎麼擦都在——這些多半是油脂、矽油或前一手留下的蠟層堆在皮面上。這支是重度型的皮革清潔劑，不是保養品：可依污垢程度從原液用到 1:10，一噴一擦處理真皮與人造皮革內裝，也能用在改色膜與車衣上的油污。清潔完成後務必再做油脂養護。翻毛皮與科技布不可使用。
1fb91b740045.en: Grease on the seats, a sticky steering wheel, a footprint on the leather seat that won't wipe off — this is usually grease, silicone oil, or old wax buildup sitting on the leather. This is a heavy-duty leather cleaner, not a conditioner: dilute anywhere from full strength to 1:10 depending on how dirty it is, then spray and wipe on real and faux leather interiors. It also works on grease on color-change wrap and PPF. Always follow up with an oil-replenishing treatment after cleaning. Not for nubuck or tech fabric.

1fc53d3c0209.en: Safety is the bottom line, not a selling point

2013c80cd24e.en: Can you use it on wheels?

203c4565f254.src: 撕完貼紙、拆掉行車紀錄器支架，留下一坨黏黏的殘膠，用刮刀怕刮傷、用強力溶劑又怕味道散不掉。這支是水性的殘膠清除配方，不含刺激性溶劑，噴上去靜置幾分鐘讓它把膠層分解，再用乾淨的超細纖維毛巾擦掉。雙面膠、不乾膠、貼紙殘膠、樹膠、蟲屍膠質都在處理範圍內，包膜店撕膜後的殘膠是它的主場。
203c4565f254.en: You peel off a sticker or pull down a dash cam mount and you're left with a sticky blob of adhesive. A scraper risks scratches, and a strong solvent can leave a smell that lingers. This is a water-based adhesive remover with no harsh solvents. Spray it on, let it sit a few minutes so it breaks down the adhesive, then wipe it off with a clean microfiber towel. It handles double-sided tape, label adhesive, sticker residue, tree sap, and bug residue. Adhesive left behind after peeling off wrap film is its specialty.

205960dfd8ad.src: 洗車泡沫太稀掛不住、洗完車一身太陽紋，問題多半出在泡沫沒做出潤滑層，手套等於直接在漆面上磨。超級泡沫是日常正洗用的洗車精，用濃密的泡沫潤滑懸浮層先把灰塵和細微顆粒吸附起來，避免擦拭過程對車體表面造成二次傷害。磨泥（黏土）去污與拋光前的預清洗，也是先用這支。
205960dfd8ad.en: If your wash foam is too thin to cling and you end up with swirl marks all over the car after washing, the problem is usually that the foam isn't building a lubricating layer, so your wash mitt is basically grinding straight on the paint. Super Foam is a car wash for everyday contact washing: the thick foam builds a lubricating, suspending layer that lifts dust and fine grit off the surface first, to help avoid secondary damage to the paint while you wipe. It's also the wash to use before claying or before polishing.

20d5a48692ce.src: 1cc原液兌1000ml純水，用手動噴壺先稀釋再施工。正常洗車後保持車身濕潤，均勻噴灑後用洗車手套帶過表面，沖淨後直接收水即完成。
20d5a48692ce.en: Mix 1cc of concentrate with 1000ml of purified water, and dilute it in a manual sprayer before applying. After a normal wash, keep the car wet, spray it on evenly, go over the surface with a wash mitt, rinse it off, then dry it — done.

210d0ac462ac.src: 漆面本身已經老化氧化的車，要先看過再決定：氧化還沒吃穿清漆的，拋得回來；如果氧化已經整層滲透進漆裡，把漆拋完了還是回不來，那是這片漆本身已經沒救，不是研磨劑的問題。車況沒把握先問，不要直接下重切。
210d0ac462ac.en: For paint that's already aged and oxidized, look at it first before you decide: if the oxidation hasn't eaten through the clear coat yet, you can polish it back. If the oxidation has soaked all the way through the paint, polishing won't bring it back — at that point the paint itself is beyond saving, it's not a compound problem. If you're not sure about the paint's condition, ask first before going straight to a heavy cut.

213f6dcad488.en: Yes, and it works especially well there. The black plastic under the front bumper is the part most prone to fading and turning white, so applying the oil brings back a deep black right away - it's where you'll see the biggest difference.

214108c9c5cf.src: 非常正常，而且這就是黏土的效果。所有附著污染物都被帶走後，漆面回到「玻璃感」的光滑狀態，這時施工鍍膜效果最好。

2878b2e373cf.src: 新手裝備建議：<g0>羊毛盤 ×1（80 番用）+ 粗棉盤 ×2（600 番用）+ 鏡面盤 ×1（1000 番用）</g0>，可以應付從重切到鏡面的全流程。羊毛盤切削力強，不熟悉的話先從中修、收尾盤練起，再上重切款。以上是起手式，不是唯一解，盤和番數怎麼配可以依施工當下的效果自己調整。

The wool pad cuts hard, so if you're new to this, practice with the medium-correction and finishing pads first before moving up to the heavy-cut pad. This is a starting point, not the only way to go - adjust the pad and grit combination based on how the job looks as you work.

2c867e199323.src: 洗車越洗刮痕越多、停在樹下沾了樹膠、鳥屎乾掉刷不掉——多半是沙塵還黏在漆面上就直接下手刷。丹若免刷預洗洗車液是洗車流程的第一步：兌水後用泡沫設備噴滿全車，讓藥劑先軟化附著的髒污，再用高壓水槍沖掉，沖洗時配合軟刷輕刷即可，不必大力擦拭。配方未添加氫氧化鈉，車身漆面、車衣、改色膜、玻璃、塑膠件、輪圈與引擎室都在適用範圍內。
2c867e199323.en: More scratches every time you wash, tree sap from parking under a tree, dried bird droppings that won't scrub off — usually it's because dust and grit are still stuck to the paint when you start scrubbing. DANRUO Touchless Pre-Wash is the first step of the wash: mix with water, spray it over the whole car with foam equipment, let it soften the dirt that's clinging on, then rinse it off with a pressure washer. A light pass with a soft brush during rinsing is all you need, no hard wiping. The formula has no added sodium hydroxide, and it can be used on paint, PPF, color-change wraps, glass, plastic trim, wheels, and the engine bay.

2ca63074b55c.src: 天使塗層 Guard 是洗完車之後用的漆面維護劑，採<g0>專用酯類配方</g0>，本身是單層穩定結構，不存在堆疊反應。它會滲透到漆面、改色膜、車衣內部覆膜，所以前置沒清乾淨會出問題。
2ca63074b55c.en: Angel Coating Guard is a paint maintenance spray you use right after washing your car. It's <g0>a purpose-made ester-based formula</g0> that forms a single, stable layer — there's no layering reaction. It soaks into the paint, color-change wrap, and PPF's film layer, so if things aren't properly cleaned beforehand, you'll run into problems.

Add <g0>1ml of concentrate</g0> (use a 5ml dropper for accuracy) to <g1>1000ml of purified water</g1> (tap water isn't recommended). 49a159804d6a.src: 雨天前擋一片霧、晚上會車覺得對向燈光特別刺眼、雨刷刷過還是留一道白痕，多半是玻璃外層積了油膜和水垢。這支用非稀土（無鈰）的低硬度自破碎研磨顆粒搭配中性基底，不靠酸性腐蝕，用在汽車前擋、側窗、後擋等外層玻璃，清除頑固油膜、長期累積的水垢與酸雨殘痕。清潔速率偏穩健，頑固的地方重複施作，不要急著加大力道。
49a159804d6a.en: If your windshield hazes over in the rain, oncoming headlights feel especially glaring at night, or the wipers still leave a white streak, it's usually oil film and mineral deposits built up on the outer glass. This uses non-rare-earth (cerium-free), low-hardness self-breaking abrasive particles in a neutral base instead of acid etching. Use it on the windshield, side windows, rear glass and other exterior glass to remove stubborn oil film, long-term mineral buildup, and acid-rain residue. It cleans at a steady, moderate rate, so go over stubborn spots again instead of pressing harder.

No.3 is silicone-free, and No.5 doesn't use oils to fill in scratches, so what you see under the light is the paint's real condition.

53079c8ebe4b.src: 拋光完成後建議立刻施工天使塗層或鍍膜，封住剛拋好的漆面。裸漆暴露時間越短，外部污染物附著越少。
53079c8ebe4b.en: After polishing, we recommend applying Angel Coating Guard or a coating right away to seal the freshly polished paint. The less time the bare paint is left exposed, the less contamination sticks to it.

533b15b0ce23.src: 兩者互補而非替代。玻璃鍍膜讓雨水自動滾落減少雨刷頻率；雨刷精讓雨刷刮水乾淨不留痕。建議兩者同時使用，雨天視線最佳。
533b15b0ce23.en: They complement each other, not replace one another. The glass coating makes rain bead up and roll off, so you use the wipers less; the Windshield Washer Concentrate keeps the wipers wiping clean with no streaks. We recommend using both together for the best visibility in the rain.

53566b540e2b.src: 一劑拋・最有效率的中切削

535b71ee391a.src: 建議每 3–6 個月做一次。住在工業區附近、常走高速公路的車輛因鐵粉累積較快，可縮短至每 2–3 個月一次。變色越深代表需求越迫切。
535b71ee391a.en: We recommend every 3–6 months. Cars kept near industrial areas or often driven on highways build up iron fallout faster, so you can shorten that to every 2–3 months. The darker the discoloration, the more urgent it is.

53ac58b98775.src: 建議馬上做。鏡面拋光後漆面最乾淨最光滑，此時施工天使塗層或鍍膜，附著力最強效果最好。建議不要讓裸漆暴露超過 24 小時。

53ce4b7241d3.en: Run all 8 steps. For polishing, judge the paint condition first to decide where to start. For deep scratches, heavy oxidation, old-car restoration or accident-damaged cars, start with the 80 grit heavy cut and run the full 3-piece set (80 → 600 → 1000). If the paint damage is within 1000 grit range, you can go straight to a one-step polish with the No.5 600 grit and a dedicated wool pad.

The POP MONSTER RO Custom Mirror Foam Pad (Black) is a high-density foam pad made for RO machines, with GA/DA custom versions also available. It comes after the cutting and polishing foam pads as the last step, for finishing and brightening only - it's not a heavy-cut pad. For deeper marks, use the cutting foam pad or the wool pad instead.

550a233ad4f9.src: 洗完車、車身還濕的時候噴全車的漆面維護劑。漆面、車衣與改色膜、玻璃、塑膠件都能用。
550a233ad4f9.en: A paint maintenance spray you apply to the whole car right after washing, while it's still wet. Works on paint, PPF and color-change film, glass, and plastic trim.

55523d16ee49.src: 本品不是酒精類清潔劑的替代品，室內或通風不良的空間請避免大面積施工。

5885d5285965.src: 內飾金屬飾條、鍍鉻件等表面同樣建議先試做，並且不要讓清潔劑長時間停留在表面。

588be174b291.src: 先用清水或預洗劑把車身表面的砂粒與大顆粒污染沖掉。

59802693fcf2.en: Our brand belief, in three parts

599163b10646.src: 先把車身洗乾淨，並完成除油膜與脫脂——本品會滲透到漆面、改色膜、車衣內部覆膜，前置沒清乾淨會出問題。
599163b10646.en: Wash the car first, then remove any oil film and degrease. This product soaks into paint, color-change film, and PPF, so if the prep isn't clean it will cause problems.

59b6deb307de.src: 嚴重氧化或太陽紋的車漆：先拋光再用塗層。氧化要先看過再決定——還沒吃穿清漆的拋得回來；整層滲透、拋完還是回不來，是這片漆本身沒救，不是研磨劑的問題
59b6deb307de.en: Paint with heavy oxidation or swirl marks: polish first, then apply the coating. You need to look at the oxidation before deciding — if it hasn't eaten through the clear coat, polishing can bring it back. If it's soaked all the way through and still won't come back after polishing, that section of paint is beyond saving. That's the paint, not the compound.

59dda78e23a2.src: 先判斷車況再決定從哪一道進場：深層刮痕、重度氧化、老車翻新、事故車從 80 番重切開始；漆面傷痕在 1000 番以內，可以直接用伍號 600 番搭專用羊毛盤一劑到底。
59dda78e23a2.en: Assess the paint's condition first to decide where to start: for deep scratches, heavy oxidation, restoring an old car, or accident repairs, start with the 80 grit heavy cut. If the paint damage is within 1000 grit, you can go straight to No.5 600 grit with its dedicated wool pad and finish in one step.

5a127187986c.src: 非矽配方、無半衰期、可徹底去除。多次施工不堆疊，不會越保養越花 — 安全是底線，不是賣點。
5a127187986c.en: Silicone-free formula, no half-life, and fully removable. Multiple applications don't build up, so more upkeep never means more marring — safety is the bottom line, not a selling point.

5a876edac7e6.src: 真空鍍塑膠件、霧面鍍鉻件、PVD 鍍膜件、已封孔陽極氧化件；鍍鉻層已脫落、穿孔、大面積起泡或鏽蝕穿透基材的受損件；非鍍鉻的漆面、玻璃、橡膠件、一般塑膠件、未經陽極處理的鋁合金件；食品接觸類鍍鉻器具（如餐具、廚具）

5e55460dda0c.src: 預洗負責在手套碰到車之前，先把大部分砂塵和髒污軟化沖掉。預洗藥劑多半偏鹼性，沖完漆面還是會留一點殘留；正洗用這支搭洗車手套再洗一遍，一方面擦掉預洗沒帶走的薄髒污，一方面把預洗留下的鹼性殘留一起帶走。
5e55460dda0c.en: Pre-wash softens and rinses off most of the grit and dirt before your mitt ever touches the car. Pre-wash products are usually alkaline, so the paint still has a bit of residue after rinsing. The contact wash, with this product and a wash mitt, goes over the car again — it wipes off the thin layer of dirt the pre-wash didn't take, and it also carries away the alkaline residue the pre-wash left behind.

6034d0896f8e.src: 剛洗好的車一曬就變花、車漆上一圈一圈的水痕、擋風玻璃白白的印怎麼擦都還在，這支就是專門處理這類水漬的。可處理頑固尿垢、車窗硬水斑、礦物沉積、擋風玻璃水斑與漆面礦物垢：塗抹在水漬處，靜置 1～2 分鐘讓它分解，再用軟布擦拭乾淨，不用費力死刷。容量 500ml，施工前請先看下方注意事項。

It handles stubborn scale buildup, hard water spots on windows, mineral deposits, windshield water spots, and mineral scale on paint: apply it to the water spot, let it sit for 1-2 minutes to break down, then wipe clean with a soft cloth. No hard scrubbing needed. Comes in 500ml. Check the precautions below before you start.

65032853975c.src: 白車反白、車上有黃印、鳥糞痕和酸雨痕怎麼洗都留在漆面上——這些不是一般髒污，是已經咬進漆面的痕漬。液體橡皮擦不含任何研磨成分，直接取適量塗抹擦拭，用來處理鳥糞、酸雨痕跡、樹膠與斑點，淺色漆車系（白、黃、銀、淺灰）效果更明顯。可以手工擦，也可以搭配偏心拋光機加超軟海綿盤。它處理的是痕漬，不是刮痕。
65032853975c.en: White cars showing dull white blotches, yellow stains on the paint, bird-dropping marks and acid-rain marks that won't wash off no matter what — these aren't ordinary dirt, they're stains that have already etched into the paint. Liquid Eraser has no abrasives in it. Apply it directly and wipe to treat bird droppings, acid-rain marks, tree sap, and spots, with more noticeable results on light-colored paint (white, yellow, silver, light gray). You can wipe it on by hand or use it with a dual-action polisher and an ultra-soft foam pad. It treats stains, not scratches.

676ebd7cb114.src: 洗完車沒幾天又卡灰、雨後留一堆水痕洗不掉——天使塗層 Guard 是洗完車之後用的漆面維護劑。正洗完車、車身還帶著水的時候直接稀釋噴上全車，用乾淨的洗車手套輕輕帶過一遍，再沖水收水就完成。漆面、車衣與改色膜、玻璃、塑膠件都能用；前擋玻璃如果已經做過鍍膜而且表面乾淨，直接噴不會互相衝突，還能緩解雨刷異響。
676ebd7cb114.en: If your car gets dusty again just a few days after washing, or rain leaves water spots that won't come off — Angel Coating Guard is a paint maintenance spray you use after washing. Right after a contact wash, while the car is still wet, dilute it and spray the whole car, go over it lightly with a clean wash mitt, then rinse and dry it off. Works on paint, PPF and color-change film, glass, and plastic trim. If the windshield already has a coating and the surface is clean, spraying it directly won't conflict, and it can even help reduce wiper noise.

6d97d82c59c1.en: A DA polisher is designed to do the work on its own. The right amount of pressure is <g0>enough for the pad to sit evenly on the paint and for you to feel the vibration, without stopping the pad from spinning</g0> - if the pad stalls, you're pressing too hard. Keep in mind that <g1>an RO doesn't give you this warning</g1>: it keeps spinning no matter how hard you press, so pressure is entirely a matter of feel, and staying a few extra seconds in one spot can burn the paint.

7307ac9ab867.en: Iron fallout keeps oxidizing and corroding the paint and wheels, and it's one of the main reasons paint loses its shine. Left untreated long enough, it can leave orange rust spots (iron fallout rust) that are hard to fix.

853f1e3b9a0c.en: Using plenty matters more than getting the amount exact. If the clay starts to drag as it slides, lubrication is running low, so spray more right away. Better to use more than you need than risk scratching the paint.

85de4b046b4c.src: 把<g0>磨泥潤滑液</g0>稀釋後（最稀不可超過 1:10）噴在漆面和黏土面，兩邊都要噴，再用<g1>洗車黏土</g1>輕推，帶走卡在漆面的鐵粉、落塵、飛漆和樹膠顆粒；表面一乾就補噴，不可乾磨。車衣、改色膜要改用細款黏土。建議每半年做一次。

Glide the <g1>clay bar</g1> lightly to lift off iron fallout, airborne dust, overspray, and sap specks stuck in the paint. Re-spray as soon as a spot dries; never clay dry. Use a fine-grade clay on PPF or color-change wrap. Recommended about every six months.

893d0df40b9c.src: 亮條發烏、鍍鉻件霧掉、排氣管黑掉，這些是鍍鉻表面的氧化腐蝕層。米速鍍鉻拋光劑是硬鍍鉻基材專用的極粗型物理研磨修復劑，不含蠟質、矽油、光學增亮劑這類臨時遮蓋成分，以物理切削方式去除氧化腐蝕層與表面瑕疵。pH 控制在 6.5~7.5 的近中性區間，不含強酸、強鹼、氫氟酸與鉻酸酐。施工前請務必先看下方的不適用材質清單。
893d0df40b9c.en: Dulled trim, hazy chrome, and blackened exhaust tips are all oxidation and corrosion on the chrome surface. MISO Chrome Polish is an extra-coarse physical restoration compound made for hard chrome substrates. It doesn't contain wax, silicone oil, or optical brighteners, the kind of ingredients that just mask the problem temporarily; it cuts away the oxidation and surface defects physically instead. pH is kept in the near-neutral 6.5-7.5 range, with no strong acids, strong bases, hydrofluoric acid, or chromic anhydride. Be sure to check the list of unsuitable surfaces below before you start.

89c40ad7ea80.src: 雨刷刷不乾淨、雨天前擋一片白茫茫、晚上會車覺得刺眼，很多人乾脆加自來水了事。這支雨刷精是中性配方，用法很單純：一整罐倒進雨刷水箱，再加清水補滿，之後照常按雨刷噴水就好，不用靜置也不用另外擦拭。一台車的用量大約 20ml。除了汽車玻璃，家裡的玻璃、磁磚也可以用。做過玻璃鍍晶的車請務必先看下方注意事項。
89c40ad7ea80.en: Streaky wipers, a hazy windshield in the rain, glare from oncoming headlights at night—a lot of people just give up and top off with tap water. This windshield washer concentrate has a neutral formula and is simple to use: pour the whole bottle into your washer fluid tank, fill the rest with water, then use your wipers and washer spray as usual. No dwell time and no extra wiping needed. One car uses about 20ml. Besides car glass, it also works on glass and tile at home. If your car has a glass ceramic-type coating, be sure to read the cautions below first.

It has the weakest cutting power and the lowest heat and burn risk, so beginners should start here.

8fb2262c661d.src: 安全。真皮本身偏弱酸性（pH 3.5–4.5），弱酸性清潔劑與皮革的 pH 接近，不會破壞皮革的天然油質層，比鹼性清潔劑對皮革更友善。

bc653c43faf4.en: Moderate swirl marks, light-to-medium scratches, and you don't want to just wade into solid black paint or piano black — MISO No.5 is the 600-grit medium-cut compound, a single product that can correct sanding marks up to 600 grit. The abrasive particles start out intact for medium cutting power, then break down into ultra-fine particles as the machine runs and shift into gloss work, so cutting and mirror finish happen in one step. It's a pure water-based formula with no fillers or oils to mask swirls, so what you see under a detailing light is the real state of the paint.

cdc4bc5119ba.src: 洗完車還是不滑、水痕水垢一圈圈洗不掉、鍍膜車的自潔性變差、拋光前後要脫脂——這支是酸性的功能性正洗泡沫，原液 pH 值約 4.0。它跟一般洗車精最大的不同是「比例決定功能」：同一瓶藥水，調濃是剝除殘留與水漬，調淡是把塗層的自潔性找回來，所以下手前要先想清楚這次要的是哪一種效果。
cdc4bc5119ba.en: Still not slick after a wash, water spots and mineral rings that won't come off, a coated car losing its self-cleaning finish, or degreasing before and after polishing — this is an acidic, functional contact-wash foam with a concentrate pH of about 4.0. What sets it apart from a regular car wash soap is that the ratio decides the function: the same bottle mixed strong strips residue and water spots, mixed weak brings the coating's self-cleaning finish back. So decide which effect you want before you start.

cdd527198c53.src: 預洗完成後，用<g0>泡沫洗車液</g0>稀釋後均勻覆蓋全車。讓泡沫停留一段時間軟化污垢，再用洗車手套從車頂開始，<g1>絕對不要打圈，要從上往下、單向直線</g1>。預洗藥劑多半偏鹼性，正洗除了擦掉預洗沒帶走的薄髒污，也會把預洗留下的鹼性殘留一起帶走，所以預洗完這一步不要省。
cdd527198c53.en: After pre-wash, dilute <g0>Foam Car Wash</g0> and cover the whole car evenly. Let the foam sit for a bit to soften the dirt, then start at the roof with a wash mitt — <g1>never circular motions, always straight lines in one direction, top to bottom</g1>. Pre-wash products are mostly alkaline, so the contact wash both wipes off the thin layer of dirt the pre-wash missed and rinses away the alkaline residue it left behind. Don't skip this step after pre-washing.

ce5497a41381.en: Regular cleaners use surfactants to emulsify stains. Liquid Eraser uses special chemical agents to break the contaminants down. The biggest difference: it has zero abrasive particles, so it doesn't clean by abrasion.

dcf7ce291ec8.src: 漆面本身已經老化、氧化的車（例如年份久的素黑本田），要先用粗番把氧化層切掉，再輪到這支收尾；直接拿拾號上去不會有效果。氧化如果已經整層滲透、把漆拋完還是回不來，那是這片漆本身已經沒救，不是研磨劑的問題。
dcf7ce291ec8.en: On cars with paint that's already aged or oxidized (like an old solid black Honda), remove the oxidized layer with a coarser grit first, then finish with this one — going straight to the No.10 won't do anything. If the oxidation has soaked all the way through and the paint still won't come back after polishing, that paint is beyond saving. It's not a compound problem.

dd0127d81934.src: 輪圈縫隙卡黑、煞車粉塵怎麼洗都在、漆面摸起來粗粗的、指甲摳也摳不下來——那是鐵粉，一般洗車精帶不走。鐵粉清潔劑是去污流程的第一道：噴上去、靜置三分鐘、高壓水沖乾淨，不用搓也不用刷。漆面、輪圈、玻璃、金屬都能噴。同一天還要做黏土或玻璃油膜的話，也是先把鐵粉這一道做完再往下走。
dd0127d81934.en: Black gunk stuck in the wheel spokes, brake dust that never washes off, paint that feels gritty, spots you can't scrape off with a fingernail—that's iron fallout, and regular car wash soap won't remove it. Iron remover is the first step in the decon process: spray it on, let it sit for three minutes, then rinse clean with high-pressure water. No scrubbing needed. You can spray it on paint, wheels, glass, and metal. If you're also doing clay or a glass oil film treatment the same day, do the iron remover step first before moving on.

e55dd444367d.src: 本支的酸鹼值與詳細規格請依瓶身標示為準，或加 LINE 向小編確認後再施工——不要照別支產品的比例調配。
e55dd444367d.en: For this product's pH and detailed specs, go by the label, or message us on WhatsApp to confirm with our team before use. Don't mix it at another product's ratio.

e55e9480ef86.src: 車主把施工選對，店家把服務說清楚。
e55e9480ef86.en: Car owners pick the right service, shops explain it clearly.

e55eb6391ec8.src: 「用黏土會不會把車刮花？」會，只要潤滑不夠就會。黏土在漆面上推的時候會吸附鐵粉和顆粒，潤滑液的作用就是把這些顆粒墊開，避免它們回頭在漆面上磨出二次刮傷。所以潤滑液不是黏土的加價配件，是同一組工具的另一半。施工時漆面和黏土面兩邊都要噴，表面一乾就立刻補噴，不要推到乾。
e55eb6391ec8.en: Will clay scratch the car? Yes, if you don't use enough lubricant. As the clay moves over the paint, it picks up iron fallout and other particles. The lubricant cushions those particles so they don't grind a second scratch into the paint. So the lubricant isn't an optional add-on to the clay, it's the other half of the same tool. Spray both the paint and the clay during application, and re-spray the moment the surface dries. Don't work it dry.

e58bc6018d57.src: 轉速請以你手上機器與所搭配研磨劑的建議值為準，不要超轉；長時間重切容易升溫，中途讓盤與漆面降溫再繼續。
e58bc6018d57.en: Go by the recommended speed for your machine and the compound you're using — don't overspeed. Extended heavy cutting builds up heat, so let the pad and paint cool down partway through before continuing.

e5e555f00881.src: 盤本身不會產生番數，切削的番數來自研磨劑，選盤要連著選劑一起看。
e5e555f00881.en: The pad itself doesn't have a grit — the cutting grit comes from the compound. Pick your pad and compound together.

e6400e34751d.src: 真羊毛切削力最強但容易噴毛、升溫快；合成羊毛切削力強且可控，不噴毛不升溫，特別適合 RO 機台和素黑軟漆。本品採合成羊毛，職人更推薦。
e6400e34751d.en: Real wool cuts the hardest but sheds fiber easily and heats up fast. Synthetic wool cuts strong and stays controllable, without shedding or heat buildup, which makes it a better fit for RO machines and soft black paint. This pad uses synthetic wool, which pro detailers recommend.

e647100a6cde.src: 請按說明操作，並先在不影響外觀的小範圍試做。
e647100a6cde.en: Follow the instructions, and test on a small, inconspicuous area first.

e69d4df8be9e.src: 稀釋時先加水再倒藥劑，搖勻。
e69d4df8be9e.en: When diluting, add water first, then the product, and shake well.

e6bf4c18a903.src: 光照3小時後表面亮度與質感即達巔峰，保守防護時長達1個月，可耐受3-4次正常洗車。
e6bf4c18a903.en: The surface reaches peak gloss and finish after 3 hours in the sun. Conservatively, protection lasts 1 month and holds up through 3-4 normal washes.

e6ce39179a9e.src: 情境 D：交車前完整流程（一整天）
e6ce39179a9e.en: Scenario D: full pre-delivery process (a full day)

e6eb20284524.src: 建議搭配羊毛盤或中硬橙色泡棉盤。
e6eb20284524.en: Use with a wool pad or medium-hard orange foam pad.

e6eecce6aaa2.src: 每月封頂 1,000 點（最多 5 人/月）
e6eecce6aaa2.en: Capped at 1,000 points a month (up to 5 people/month)

e6ef239e2f9a.src: 素黑車、鋼琴烤漆這類軟漆最難搞：盤子掉毛留痕、拋一拋就升溫，深刮痕想一刀到位又怕拋穿咬漆，很多師傅乾脆不敢放手。這片 RO 訂製羊毛盤是專為高端素黑車、嬌貴軟漆量身打造的款式，RO、GA、DA 全機型都能裝。盤徑、硬度與建議轉速目前沒有正式公告數據，選盤或搭配研磨劑前，歡迎先加 LINE 問小編。
e6ef239e2f9a.en: Soft black paint and piano black finishes are the toughest to work on: pads shed fiber and leave marks, the panel heats up fast, and going after a deep scratch in one pass risks cutting through the paint. A lot of detailers just won't risk it. This RO Custom Wool Pad is built specifically for high-end cars with soft black paint and other delicate finishes. It fits RO, GA, and DA machines. We haven't published official numbers yet for pad diameter, hardness, or recommended speed, so message us on WhatsApp before you choose a pad or pair it with a compound.

e77e6b8dcc52.src: 施工前用美紋紙膠帶完全遮蔽周邊漆面、塑膠件、橡膠件、玻璃等非鍍鉻基材。
e77e6b8dcc52.en: Before you start, fully mask off surrounding paint, plastic, rubber, glass, and any other non-chrome surfaces with painter's tape.

e7c52f141fd4.src: 各種汽車車漆（尤其淺色漆車系）、車衣；汽車金屬飾件、輪圈等金屬製品
e7c52f141fd4.en: All car paint types (especially light-colored paint), PPF; metal trim, wheels, and other metal parts

e82edc12fbd0.src: 高速公路開回來，車尾、保桿一排黑點；停在樹下一晚，樹膠黏得擦不動——這種柏油和樹膠，用洗車精洗不掉，硬擦只會把漆面刮花。柏油清潔劑的用法是塗上去讓它自己分解，靜置後用軟布把污漬帶走。車身帶水也能分解，不用等車身全乾，可以直接排在洗車流程中間做。
e82edc12fbd0.en: Drive home on the highway and you get a row of black spots on the rear and bumper. Park under a tree overnight and the sap turns sticky and won't wipe off. Car wash soap won't take off tar and sap like this, and scrubbing hard just scratches the paint. With tar remover, you apply it, let it break the grime down on its own, then wipe the residue away with a soft cloth. It still works on a wet car, so you don't need to wait for the car to dry — you can do this step right in the middle of your wash.

e84ec2961e69.src: 越大越細。這個系統來自磨砂紙，越大顆粒越細。所以 80 番 = 粗，1000 番 = 細。
e84ec2961e69.en: Higher number means finer. This numbering comes from sandpaper — the higher the number, the finer the particles. So 80 grit = coarse, 1000 grit = fine.

e8b0fb82715b.en: Turn a topic into a full script

e8b6bc6e804d.src: 米速系列的特色配方降低了研磨時的發熱，但<g0>燒漆的主因是操作（壓力、時間、轉速），不是研磨劑</g0>。正確解讀是「在正常操作下不易燒漆」。
e8b6bc6e804d.en: The MISO formula reduces heat buildup during compounding, but <g0>the main cause of burnt paint is technique (pressure, dwell time, speed), not the compound</g0>. The accurate way to put it: "unlikely to burn paint under normal technique."

e8c74664a9ee.en: What pad should I use with it?

e9327063d32c.src: 用清水從車頂沖洗一次，把多餘的塗層液帶走。然後用麂皮或吸水巾正常收水即可。這時水珠的集中度與收水的俐落度，明顯比沒做塗層時更乾淨。
e9327063d32c.en: Rinse once with clean water starting from the roof to wash away the excess coating. Then dry it off as usual with a chamois or a water-absorbing towel. At this point the water beads tighter and dries off cleaner than it would without the coating.

e9523008bd66.src: 從預洗到鍍膜的 8 個步驟，職人級的完整動線。
e9523008bd66.en: The 8 steps from pre-wash to coating — a full pro-detailer routine.

e95db39e875a.src: 油膜是沥青、矽油蠟、廢氣附著在玻璃上形成的油脂層，讓視線在雨天模糊、迎光視角嚴重眩光。判斷方式：夜間迎面燈光看起來特別刺眼、雨天雨刷刮過後留痕，就是有油膜。
e95db39e875a.en: Oil film is a greasy layer that forms on glass from asphalt residue, silicone wax, and exhaust — it blurs your view in the rain and causes bad glare when facing oncoming light. How to tell: if oncoming headlights look unusually glaring at night, or the wipers leave a streak in the rain, you've got oil film.

e9882a6b4193.src: 旋轉式重切一定會留下眩紋（也叫機械紋、太陽紋），這是重切的正常結果、不是產品問題；重切完務必再用細番研磨劑收尾，沒收尾就交車，車子推到太陽底下會非常明顯。
e9882a6b4193.en: A rotary heavy cut will always leave holograms (also called buffer trails or swirl marks); that's a normal result of heavy cutting, not a product problem. Always follow up with a fine-grit compound to finish. Skip that step and hand the car back, and it'll show up badly in direct sunlight.

e9d778ed94da.en: Washing your own car, or running a shop?

ea43d96fbf70.src: 洗完車，漆面摸起來還是粗粗澀澀的，還有一顆一顆摳不掉的黑點，那是鐵粉、工業落塵、飛漆和樹膠卡在漆面上，洗車精洗不掉。這支是車漆專用的粗款去污泥，搭配磨泥潤滑液以畫圈方式輕推，把卡在漆面的顆粒帶下來，是拋光、鍍膜前的前置工序。隱形車衣、改色膜、包膜面請改用細款，粗款不要上。
ea43d96fbf70.en: After washing, the paint still feels rough and gritty, with little black specks you can't pick off. That's iron fallout, industrial dust, overspray and tree sap stuck in the paint, and car wash soap won't remove it. This is the heavy-grade clay bar made for paint. Glide it lightly in circles with the Clay Lubricant to lift those particles off. It's the prep step before polishing or coating. On PPF, color-change wrap and wrapped panels, use the fine-grade bar instead. Don't use the heavy-grade bar there.

eaaa8a3030fa.src: 以下為瓶身標籤〈注意事項〉欄所載：吞食可能有害；濺入眼睛可能引起眼睛刺激；請放置在兒童接觸不到的地方；如接觸眼睛或皮膚請立即用大量清水沖洗；請勿在高溫環境下施工；請勿長期曝曬或高溫存放於車內。
eaaa8a3030fa.en: From the bottle label's Precautions section: may be harmful if swallowed; may cause eye irritation if splashed in the eyes; keep out of reach of children; if it contacts eyes or skin, flush immediately with plenty of water; do not apply in high-heat conditions; do not store in the car long-term in sun or heat.

eb049d52cea9.src: 黑色車頂上放著一瓶米速伍號，旁邊是正在運轉的 RO 拋光機
eb049d52cea9.en: A bottle of MISO No.5 sits on a black car roof, with a rotary polisher (RO) running next to it.

eb085c0eb432.src: 將稀釋好的潤滑液均勻噴灑到需要清潔的漆面，以及黏土面——兩邊都要噴，多數人只噴漆面。
eb085c0eb432.en: Spray the diluted lubricant evenly over the paint you're cleaning and over the clay itself — both need it. Most people only spray the paint.

eb6788e63955.src: 清潔結束後用清水把漆面沖洗乾淨。
eb6788e63955.en: When you're done, rinse the paint clean with water.

eb9c2561c34b.src: 靜置約 2 分鐘後，用清水徹底沖洗乾淨。
eb9c2561c34b.en: Let it sit for about 2 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water.

ebaabe653357.src: 施工：保持玻璃濕潤，取本品以畫圈方式塗抹玻璃，手工擦拭或機具拋光都可以。
ebaabe653357.en: Application: Keep the glass wet and apply this product in a circular motion, by hand or with a polisher.

ebc77b5e2467.src: 改裝零件、電鍍件、陽極氧化表面施工要極度謹慎，風險客觀存在；如果一定要用，請加大稀釋比例，並先在隱蔽處小範圍測試沒有異常再決定。
ebc77b5e2467.en: Use extreme caution on aftermarket parts, chrome-plated parts, and anodized surfaces — the risk is real. If you do need to use it, dilute it more and test a small hidden area first. Only go ahead if nothing looks wrong.

ebf0efa4e79b.src: 不要讓藥劑長時間留在漆面上或自然乾掉。
ebf0efa4e79b.en: Don't let the product sit on the paint for a long time or dry on its own.

ec88d9714e67.en: Tar remover is formulated for the specific chemistry of tar and asphalt, so it dissolves it faster. Adhesive remover is for glue residue. They're built for different jobs, each with its own strength, so it's worth keeping both on hand.

eef9823fb1ad.src: 建議施工後使用保護蠟或護亮劑（不含研磨顆粒的那種）做一層保護。鍍鉻件暴露在空氣中會重新氧化，定期保護可延緩這個過程。
eef9823fb1ad.en: We recommend applying a coat of protective wax or a shine sealant (the kind without abrasives) after the job. Chrome parts re-oxidize when exposed to air, so regular protection slows this down.

f1951ae06038.src: 陽光下車漆有反射光暈但表面平整。<g0>不需要研磨</g0>，做維護劑或鍍膜即可。
f1951ae06038.en: The paint shows a halo of reflected light in the sun but the surface is smooth. <g0>No compounding needed</g0> — a maintenance product or a coating is enough.

f1b530f15fdf.src: 黏土用後清洗乾淨可重複使用；一旦掉到地上就直接丟棄，不可以再上車。
f1b530f15fdf.en: Rinse the clay clean after use and you can reuse it. If it drops on the ground, throw it out. Don't put it back on the car.

f205526e6aa3.src: 差別很大。一般玻璃清潔劑只能去除浮面灰塵和水漬，對油膜完全無效。油膜去除膏含有特殊研磨成分，能物理研磨去除附著的油脂層，效果完全不同。
f205526e6aa3.en: Big difference. A regular glass cleaner only removes surface dust and water marks — it does nothing for oil film. This oil-film remover has abrasive particles that physically cut through the greasy layer, so the results aren't comparable.

f25e4c9047cc.src: POP CARD 是我們做給汽美店的系統：服務菜單、預約、會員、車況紀錄和帳本放在同一個地方。它跟官網的購物車、會員資料分開，不互通。
f25e4c9047cc.en: POP CARD is the system we built for detailing shops: service menu, bookings, memberships, vehicle records, and the ledger all in one place. It's separate from the site's cart and membership data — the two don't sync.

f26ce84aefa4.src: 我們設計的是能做 30 年的會員制，不是 30 個月就崩盤的暴衝模式。速度不是目標，穩定才是。
f26ce84aefa4.en: We're designing a membership program meant to last 30 years, not a fast-growth model that collapses in 30 months. Speed isn't the goal. Stability is.

fc5beaa84b8c.src: 開始前先摸一下車身：剛跑完車或曬過太陽、摸起來燙手的，先停到陰涼處，等降回常溫、不超過 40°C 左右再洗，藥劑才不會乾在車上。在用洗車手套碰觸車身前，先把鬆散的灰塵與沙粒沖走。使用<g0>丹若免刷預洗液</g0>兌水後用泡沫設備噴滿全車，讓藥劑先軟化附著的髒污，再用高壓水沖洗。跳過預洗最常見的後果是車漆出現大量太陽紋。
fc5beaa84b8c.en: Before you start, touch the body panels. If the car was just driven or sat in the sun and feels hot, park it in the shade and let it cool back to ambient temperature, no more than about 40°C, before washing, so the product doesn't dry on the paint. Before your wash mitt touches the body, rinse off loose dust and grit first. Dilute <g0>DANRUO Touchless Pre-Wash</g0> with water, cover the whole car with a foam cannon, let it soften the stuck-on dirt, then rinse with a pressure washer. The most common result of skipping pre-wash is heavy swirl marks in the paint.

fd7c2decee1f.src: 傳統的車漆養護產品大致可以分成蠟、封體劑、鍍膜這三個層次。蠟是最早期的解法，提供短期光澤與輕度撥水，但耐久度最弱。封體劑加入了高分子聚合物，可以撐到 1–3 個月。鍍膜則進入無機矽烷或石墨烯領域，提供半年到兩年不等的保護。
fd7c2decee1f.en: Traditional paint care products fall roughly into three tiers: wax, sealant, and coating. Wax is the oldest option — it gives short-term shine and light water beading, but it doesn't last long. Sealants add polymers and can hold up for 1–3 months. Coatings move into inorganic silane or graphene chemistry, protecting anywhere from six months to two years.
